statement: Iran launches at least one drone or missile attack at Bahraini territory, including US facilities in Bahrain, between 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-29.
resolution: TRUE if the government of Bahrain or US Central Command states that Iranian drones or missiles were launched at Bahraini territory between 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-29, as reported by at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC. Otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No Iranian drone or missile was launched at Bahraini territory between 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-29.

statement: US forces strike at least one target on Iranian land territory, mainland or islands, between 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-29.
resolution: TRUE if the Pentagon, US Central Command or the White House confirms, or at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP report citing US officials, a US strike on Iranian land territory between 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-29. Otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: US forces struck no target on Iranian land territory between 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-29.

statement: The WTI spot price at Cushing, FRED series DCOILWTICO, is at or above 95.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-11. Reference: 88.56 dollars on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if any FRED DCOILWTICO daily value dated between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-11 is 95.00 or higher. Reference: 88.56 dollars on the packet date. Otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Every DCOILWTICO daily value dated between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-11 is below 95.00 dollars.

statement: Nvidia reports revenue of at least 110.16 billion dollars, the top of its own guidance range, for its fiscal Q3 2027 quarter ended 2026-10-25, in results scheduled for release on 2026-11-17.
resolution: TRUE if revenue for the quarter ended 2026-10-25, in Nvidia results filed on SEC EDGAR between 2026-11-17 and 2026-11-23, is at least 110.16 billion dollars. Reference: guidance 108.0 billion plus or minus 2 percent. Otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Nvidia revenue for the quarter ended 2026-10-25 is below 110.16 billion dollars, or no results for that quarter are released by 2026-11-23.

statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range by at least 50 basis points, to an upper bound of 4.50 percent or higher, at its meeting concluding on 2026-12-09. Reference: upper bound 4.00 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DFEDTARU for 2026-12-10 is 4.50 or higher, reflecting the FOMC decision announced on 2026-12-09. Reference: 4.00 percent on the packet date. Otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: The target range upper bound set by the FOMC decision of 2026-12-09 is below 4.50 percent.

statement: In its judgment delivered on 2026-11-19 in The Gambia v. Myanmar, the International Court of Justice finds that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya in violation of the Genocide Convention.
resolution: TRUE if the operative clause of the ICJ judgment in case 178, delivered on 2026-11-19 and published on icj-cij.org, finds that Myanmar committed genocide in violation of its obligations under the Genocide Convention. Otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: The ICJ judgment in The Gambia v. Myanmar does not find that Myanmar committed genocide, or no judgment is delivered by 2026-11-23.

statement: A new Israeli government headed by Gadi Eisenkot wins a Knesset confidence vote between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the Knesset approves a government headed by Gadi Eisenkot in a confidence vote held between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-31, per the official Knesset record or both Reuters and AP. Otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No government headed by Gadi Eisenkot wins a Knesset confidence vote between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-31.

statement: The United States, China and Russia issue one joint written statement agreed by all three governments in connection with the Trump-Xi-Putin meeting scheduled for 2026-11-19 in Shenzhen, published between 2026-11-18 and 2026-11-25.
resolution: TRUE if one joint statement text of the United States, China and Russia is published between 2026-11-18 and 2026-11-25 on at least two of whitehouse.gov, kremlin.ru, mfa.gov.cn. Separate national readouts do not count. Otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No joint statement agreed by all three of the United States, China and Russia is issued between 2026-11-18 and 2026-11-25.

statement: Between 2026-11-15 and 2027-01-31, a person is criminally charged in federal or Illinois state court over the explosive device found on 2026-11-13 at the BioUrja Renewables ethanol plant in Peoria, Illinois.
resolution: TRUE if a DOJ or US Attorney press release, a court docket, or the Peoria County prosecutor shows charges filed between 2026-11-15 and 2027-01-31 against a person over the Peoria BioUrja explosive device. Otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No person is charged over the Peoria BioUrja explosive device between 2026-11-15 and 2027-01-31.

statement: The CDC cumulative count of confirmed 2026 US measles cases reaches at least 7,000 in a CDC update published between 2026-11-16 and 2027-01-08. Reference: 5,412 cases as of 2026-11-12.
resolution: TRUE if any CDC measles cases and outbreaks update published between 2026-11-16 and 2027-01-08 reports at least 7,000 confirmed 2026 US cases. Reference: 5,412 as of 2026-11-12. Otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Confirmed 2026 US measles cases counted by CDC stay below 7,000 in every update published between 2026-11-16 and 2027-01-08.
